aomori-nebuta-matsuri.name: Aomori Nebuta Matsuri

editions.note: Fixed 2–7 Aug every year; parades of giant illuminated nebuta floats through central Aomori. Daily schedule for 2027 not published yet.

aomori-nebuta-matsuri.approx_cost: Watching from the street is free; paid reserved seating exists (prices not confirmed)

aomori-nebuta-museum-wa-rasse.name: Nebuta Museum Wa Rasse
aomori-nebuta-museum-wa-rasse.approx_cost: Nebuta hall ¥620 adults, ¥460 high-school students, ¥260 elementary/junior-high (groups ¥550/¥410/¥230); free for Aomori-city schoolchildren; shop and restaurant free to enter

closed.irregular: Tourism sites also list 9–10 Aug as closed (replacement of the displayed nebuta after the festival); may close for maintenance

aomori-nebuta-museum-wa-rasse.best_season: all year (August for the festival itself)

aomori-sannai-maruyama.name: Sannai-Maruyama Jomon Site
aomori-sannai-maruyama.approx_cost: Permanent exhibition incl. the site: ¥500 adults, ¥250 university students, high school and younger free (groups ¥400/¥200); special exhibitions extra; discount with a same-day Aomori Museum of Art collection ticket stub
aomori-sannai-maruyama.hours: Oct–May 9:00-17:00 (last entry 16:30); Golden Week and Jun–Sep 9:00-18:00 (last entry 17:30)

closed.irregular: Plus maintenance days; in 2026 the July closure was 13 Jul (2nd Monday) — check the official calendar

aomori-sannai-maruyama.address_local: 〒038-0031 青森県青森市青森環状道路

tokyo-to-aomori.name: Tokyo ↔ Aomori
tokyo-to-aomori.approx_cost: Hayabusa Tokyo → Shin-Aomori, reserved ordinary seat ¥18,110 regular season after the March 2026 revision (eTicket ¥17,910; off-peak −¥200, peak +¥200, busiest +¥400). Old figure ¥17,670 on some pages. Change at Shin-Aomori for Aomori Station. Travel time not confirmed.
